applications.description: List of applications recognized by firetools; each entry defines how an app appears in the GUI and optional sandboxing command.

applications.executable.description: Path or command name of the executable.

applications.icon.description: Path or theme icon name for the application.

applications.firejail_cmd.description: Optional Firejail sandbox command with arguments (e.g., 'firejail mpv --player-operation-mode=pseudo-gui').
